gbm_population_evidence.quote: Presumptive glioblastoma according to radiological criteria,

candidate_evidence.quote: The patient will receive 5-ALA ( 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride),GLIOLAN drinkable 6h before surgery + lighting of the tumor bed by a red light source

candidate_flag.reason: 5-ALA is a photosensitiser drug whose antitumour effect requires a light device (PDT); judged pharmacological per manual 4.2 note on 5-ALA.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: maximum removal surgery followed by radiochemotherapy according to the Stupp protocol

flag.reason: 5-ALA with intraoperative light (device) is the only experimental element; Stupp therapy is background.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Gliolan: patient will receive 5-ALA 4 to 6 hours before surgery

agents.drug_class_hint: photosensitiser prodrug (5-ALA, protoporphyrin IX) for photodynamic therapy

flag.reason: Photosensitiser needs light device for antitumour action.

role_evidence.quote: This treatment will be performed in addition to the current reference treatment of glioblastoma: maximum removal surgery followed by radiochemotherapy according to the Stupp protocol.

flag.reason: Temozolomide is implied by 'Stupp protocol' rather than named.

coder_notes: Hemerion Therapeutics is a collaborator (company). Light dose is escalated across arms; 5-ALA dose is constant.
